metadata.explanation: The sound-horizon prediction r_d shows how the early-universe sound horizon shrinks slightly in PBUF due to modified wave speed in the denser early medium. This shift naturally alleviates the H0 tension. Precision BAO analyses can measure whether r_d matches this predicted reduction.
